extra.reason: Verdict: usable with workarounds. KiCanvas parses all 20 converted files (version 20260306) and builds the hierarchy; owner confirmed in Safari that sheets fed from memory render and that the KiCad colour scheme (localStorage kc:prefs:theme = kicad) looks right. Workarounds, all in the approved spec: page-supplied sheet list with one embed per sheet, theme via localStorage, self-hosted icon font instead of fonts.googleapis.com, title-block 1/1 counter accepted as a stated limitation.
Spec approved by the owner on 2026-10-03 after two external review rounds: doc/specs/2026-10-03-web-converter-design.md (not yet committed).

scripts/build-wasm committed: wasm32-wasi-ghc -O1 + wasm-opt -Oz -> web/dsn2kicad.wasm (2.1 MB, git-ignored), cached objects, ~7 s cold build here; exits 1 naming missing tools without the toolchain. wasmtime run is exercised by the parity test (.5).

Fixed: pageHeaderModified :: Maybe Word32, range check in Word32, isoDateFromUnix divides to days before narrowing. Parity test shows the unfixed code drops the date under wasm and a guard-only fix prints 2038-01-19 as 1901-12-13; both green now. Native suite unchanged (215 passed).

tests/test_wasm_parity.py: timestamp boundary fixture, OLE options fixture (defaults and all flags), artwork fixture, optional real-design corpus via ORCAD2KICAD_PARITY_DSN_DIR (33/33 identical locally). Skips without toolchain; ORCAD2KICAD_REQUIRE_WASM=1 turns that into failure (verified).

web/runner.js + web/worker.js (blob: bootstrap in app.js), vendored browser_wasi_shim 0.4.2 with a UTF-8 argv-size patch. Runner output byte-identical to native via the parity test; node tests cover options, errors, fresh instances, non-ASCII names. Commits 2969ecf, 88cfde1.

Page committed in 88cfde1: input routes, 100 MB File.size gate, worker-side ZIP extraction (own central-directory reader, fflate Inflate in 16 KiB pushes with a running bound), options with re-run, archive download. 25 node tests on input/archive incl. data-descriptor, encrypted, truncated, lying-size and chunking-mutation cases. Playwright run in Chromium/Firefox/WebKit: all routes except drag-and-drop and paste exercised (picker only); phone width has no horizontal overflow.

web/preview.js: page-supplied sheet list in root order (Sheetname titles), one KiCanvas embed per sheet fed inline, KiCad theme via localStorage, controlslist=nodownload. KiCanvas bundle vendored with the Google Fonts link removed. Renders in Chromium, Firefox, WebKit (screenshots checked). Known harmless quirks recorded in web/vendor/README.md.

CSP meta in web/index.html: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; worker-src/child-src 'self' blob:; base-uri/form-action 'none'. Verified 2026-10-03 with Playwright 1.x engines (Chromium, Firefox 155, WebKit 26.6) against a local server: no request to any other origin during a full session; fetch to https://example.com refused in the page and inside the blob: worker in all three (Chromium and Firefox fire a connect-src violation in the worker; WebKit refuses with a console CSP error but fires no event in the worker). Finding: module workers fetch their imports with destination 'worker', so worker-src needs 'self' as well as blob:. Not yet re-checked on the deployed GitHub Pages origin or in branded Safari.
Fixed in partitionArgs (reverse positional ++ rest); three parametrised tests in tests/test_dsn2kicad_hk.py, two of which failed before the fix. Full suite 222 passed.

NOTICE corrected in e346baa. Page footer credits KiCanvas (MIT), browser_wasi_shim (MIT or Apache-2.0), fflate (MIT), states GPL-2.0-or-later and links the source at the deployed commit (from version.json). The web build does not ship scripts/kicad_symbols (the Haskell converter draws its own R/C/power glyphs), so no CC-BY-SA attribution is needed on the page.

Workflow .github/workflows/pages.yml green end to end (run for 1c41d46): pinned ghc-wasm-meta ded427a (cached), GHC 9.14.1, Python 3.14, Node 22; build-wasm; pytest with ORCAD2KICAD_REQUIRE_WASM=1 (222 incl. wasm parity); node tests; deploy to https://andrei-errapart.github.io/Orcad2Kicad/. Pages enabled via API with build_type=workflow. Manual checklist run headless with Playwright against the live site in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit: all steps pass, no foreign requests. CI fixes needed on the way: YAML quoting, Python 3.12 -> 3.14 (OLB XML attr escaping), runghc test timeouts, node --test glob, and a worker start-up race in app.js found only on the live site.
Docs in d4565ca, node --test invocation corrected in fe25b4e.
Browser-only converter live at https://andrei-errapart.github.io/Orcad2Kicad/, deployed by .github/workflows/pages.yml on every push to main. All children closed.
